text:
Alex: kicking off engine-v3.14-kquant-2026-03-21 into night-bucket. starting a tiny canary 5% for 30m. pin TTL set to 30m. release notes draft: https://gist.local/rw/engine-v3.14
Priya: ack. which quant profile?
Alex: q8_fast with fp-fallback. build q8f-20260321-rc2.
Marta: add an immediate smoke gate after first 100 samples: p95 latency, p90 mem, and error-rate check. if any fail we abort and pin.
Ryan: include a memory headroom rule too — last rollout saw kv-cache jump. rule: mem p90 > 82% => rollback.
Alex: agreed. smoke criteria: p95 < 120ms, mem p90 < 80%, error-rate < 1.5x baseline.
deploy-bot: [deploy] starting rollout engine-v3.14-kquant-2026-03-21 -> night-bucket (canary 5%)
deploy-bot: rollout id=rb-1765432109-01, pinned=false, ttl=1800s
Priya: tagging observability runbook ops/runbooks/engine-canary.yaml and paging @oncall-liz on threshold breaches.
Liz: oncall here. post the exact smoke queries and I'll watch dashboards.
Marta: smoke queries:
```
query latency.p95(filter:bucket=night) * 1000
query memory.p90(filter:hostgroup=engine-night)
query error.rate(1m)
```
Reply with "rollback" in-thread if any trigger fires.
Ryan: canary traffic plan: t+0 start 5%, t+10m -> 20%, t+20m -> 50%, t+30m -> full. if unstable drain to 0% immediately and pin previous bundle.
Alex: updating release-notes with ABI fallback and kv-cache layout note. adding x-kv-sample-id header to traces to capture warms.
Priya: apply temporary routing policy preferring engine-compat-v2 for low-latency customer routes (/v1/generate.lowlatency) during canary, fallback ttl 60s.
Alex: routing tag set: engine-routing:prefer=compat-v2 for the route.
deploy-bot: [smoke] initial samples n=120. p95=98ms, mem p90=64%, error-rate=0.2% — within thresholds :thumbsup:
Liz: good so far, watching.
Marta: note for postmortem: persist kv-cache warm sample ids for first 15m.
Alex: implemented kv-sample header and hooked to tracing.
Ryan: short customer-facing blurb for Dedicated teams about transient variability prepared.
Alex: marking canary as "in-progress - canary stable" and scaling per plan.
deploy-bot: [rollout] scaled to 20% (rb-1765432109-01). next checkpoint at t+20m.
Priya: reminder to add the change window to release-calendar and email partners group for Dedicated.
Liz: saw error spike from 0.9% -> 1.6% at t+8m, still under the 1.5x baseline multiplier threshold. monitoring GC metrics.
Marta: watch for correlated GC or OOM churn. if GC pause p99 > 250ms we consider rollback.
Alex: rollback plan: immediate drain, pin to engine-v3.13-hotfix-20260210, open rollback PR and notify customers.
deploy-bot: heartbeat OK. next autoscale check in 8m.
Priya: prepping rollback notes and docs in case.
Ryan: also prepping the hotfix backport checklist for the kv-cache tweak.
Alex: will update thread after final status. continuing monitoring. :rocket:
